exposure: immunohistochemical stainings (anti MNF116, actin-SM, HPL, vimentin, GATA3 antibodies)
outcome: measurement of depth of infiltration into the myometrium
grading of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) disorders
cohort: The study included 30 cases of gravid hysterectomy with a histopathologic diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS).
finding: Immunohistochemistry, especially double immunostainings with actin-SM and cytokeratins, HPL, or GATA3, enhances the identification of extravillous trophoblast invasion and improves the reproducible grading of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS).
